title: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Staging

blueprintSignals.name: Lifetime PD ratio
blueprintSignals.definition: current lifetime PD divided by lifetime PD at origination
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: The origination PD must be preserved, not re-estimated

blueprintSignals.name: Days past due flag
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Counted on contractual due dates, not posting dates

blueprintSignals.name: Watchlist and forbearance
blueprintSignals.definition: internal flags for credit concern or concession
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Flags must have effective dates to avoid leakage

blueprintSignals.name: Macro sensitivity
blueprintSignals.definition: portfolio PD elasticity to unemployment and rates
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Sensitivities are estimated on few downturns

label: For "IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Staging": Allocate each exposure to IFRS 9 stage 1, 2 or 3 and estimate lifetime expected loss so provisions respond to deteriorating credit without whipsaw. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Random split ignores economic cycles.
